convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom with external XRSIDeMarker indicator (.ex5 or .mq5 custom indicator not available as built-in). The histogram approach requires custom indicator buffer reads. Entry/exit logic is moderately complex but the custom indicator dependency requires manual replication of the XRSIDeMarker logic in Python.

derived_values.name: XRSIDeMarker composite value
derived_values.formula: normalized combination of RSI and DeMarker

other_exits: Close long on histogram crossing below zero/signal line
Close short on histogram crossing above zero/signal line

position_sizing.conditional_logic: negative input value = fixed lots, positive input value = deposit fraction percentage

custom_logic_notes: XRSIDeMarker is a composite oscillator combining RSI and DeMarker values into a normalized histogram. The EA typically uses histogram sign changes (positive/negative) for direction and zero-line crossovers for entry. Signal reversal closes existing position before opening opposite. Uses previous bar values [1] for signal confirmation to avoid repainting. Position sizing uses a dual-mode input where negative values mean fixed lots and positive values mean deposit percentage fraction.
python_conversion_notes: Must replicate XRSIDeMarker indicator logic in Python: compute RSI and DeMarker separately, then combine into normalized histogram. The DeMarker can be calculated using ta-lib or manual implementation. Histogram zero-line crossover is the primary signal. Use previous completed bar values only (shift=1) to match MT5 non-repainting behavior. Implement position gate check (no_position) before entry. Implement dual-mode lot sizing (negative=fixed lots, positive=deposit fraction).
